OUR VISION

Every exception, source and owner traceable.

The ambition is a shared operational context across supply teams, clinicians and purchasing. Expansion depends on permission, reliable data and measurable operational gain.

OUR MISSION

Start narrow enough to learn.

01

One device family

A high-variance perioperative item family with a concrete shortage history.

02

One read-only path

Authorized inventory and schedule discovery, with explicit mappings.

03

One governed test

A named sponsor, agreed baseline and human review before action.

CURRENT STAGE

The evidence is still to be earned.

01

What exists

A website concept and an isolated synthetic product demonstration.

02

What is not established

Revenue, demand, real customers, live integrations, clinical efficacy or compliance.

03

What comes next

Interviews, mapping assessment, historical replay and a conditional paid sponsor.
